name: HireIQ
tagline: Recruit smarter. Evaluate better. Hire with confidence.
summary: An intelligent ATS platform that evaluates resumes against job descriptions using evidence-based matching and deterministic candidate scoring.
heroTitle: Recruit smarter. Evaluate better. Hire with confidence.
heroBody: HireIQ reads the job description, reads the resume, and produces a 100-point score with the evidence behind it — so every shortlist can be explained.
metaTitle: HireIQ — AI Resume Screening & Recruitment Intelligence | TaskNera
metaDescription: HireIQ by TaskNera evaluates resumes against job descriptions with deterministic 100-point scoring, mandatory requirement validation and evidence-backed candidate evaluation.
intro: Most screening tools rank candidates with a single opaque confidence number. Recruiters cannot explain it to a hiring manager, and hiring managers cannot defend it to anyone else.

HireIQ takes a different approach. Matching is deterministic: the same job description and the same resume always produce the same score, calculated against weighted, visible criteria and supported by citations from the candidate's own resume.

problems.title: Opaque candidate ranking
problems.text: Black-box scores give recruiters no way to justify why one candidate ranked above another.

problems.title: Missed mandatory requirements
problems.text: Candidates without a non-negotiable qualification still reach shortlists because nothing validated it.

problems.title: Slow, inconsistent screening

capabilities: AI-assisted resume parsing into structured candidate data
Job description intelligence and requirement extraction
benefits: Shortlists a hiring manager can review and trust
The same criteria applied to every candidate, every time
Less time spent on manual resume screening
Clear reporting on pipeline quality and progress

process.text: Job descriptions, mandatory requirements and scoring weights are set up.

faqs.q: How does the 100-point score work?
faqs.a: Each job description is broken into weighted criteria. Candidate evidence is matched against those criteria, with mandatory requirements validated first, producing a score out of 100 with the supporting resume evidence attached.

faqs.q: Is the scoring deterministic?
faqs.a: Yes. The same job description and resume combination produces the same score, which is what makes the result reviewable and comparable across a pipeline.

faqs.q: Does HireIQ replace recruiters?
faqs.a: No. It replaces manual first-pass screening and inconsistent ranking. Recruiters still own calibration, conversation, assessment and the hiring decision.

faqs.q: How do we see HireIQ in practice?
faqs.a: Request a demonstration through the enquiry form and we will walk through screening a live role with sample resumes.
